tools.description: Read one Track's complete Bucket membership set and its current membership revision.

tools.name: add_track_bucket_membership
tools.description: Prepare one reviewed Track Bucket membership change. The saved plan freezes membership, entitlement, coverage and delivery effects.

tools.name: remove_track_bucket_membership
tools.description: Prepare one reviewed Track Bucket membership change. The saved plan freezes membership, entitlement, coverage and delivery effects.

tools.name: set_track_bucket_memberships
tools.description: Prepare one reviewed Track Bucket membership change. The saved plan freezes membership, entitlement, coverage and delivery effects.

tools.name: execute_track_bucket_membership_action
tools.description: Execute one reviewed Track Bucket membership plan. The trusted app approval must match the saved plan; read the operation after an unknown outcome.

tools.name: prepare_track_metadata_batch
tools.description: Prepare a reviewed bounded batch of ordinary Track metadata edits. Track IDs, revisions and fields are frozen before any mutation.

tools.name: execute_track_metadata_batch
tools.description: Execute one reviewed Track metadata batch plan. The saved complete selection and revisions are the only mutation targets.

tools.name: get_track_edit_action_plan
tools.description: Read one account and client bound Track edit plan without executing it.

tools.name: get_track_edit_action_operation
tools.description: Read one original Track edit operation. Use the original idempotency key after an unknown outcome.

tools.name: cancel_track_edit_action_plan
tools.description: Cancel one prepared Track edit plan before execution. Cancellation cannot undo completed effects.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Create a new comment on a song (track group)

file_path.description: Canonical local or Dropbox bounce path

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment

tools.name: create_todo
tools.description: Create a new todo item, optionally linked to a song

tools.name: update_todo
tools.description: Update a todo item (content and/or completion status)

tools.name: delete_todo
tools.description: Delete a todo item

tools.name: get_recent_activity
tools.description: Get recent activity feed

tools.name: get_subscription_status
tools.description: Get current subscription status

tools.name: get_library_stats
tools.description: Get a summary of your library: total song count and breakdown by stage. Much faster than listing all songs.

bucket_id.description: Filter stats to a specific bucket

tools.name: create_share_page
tools.description: Create a share page (playlist link) for selected songs. Provide track_group_ids directly, OR set bucket_id or stages to auto-select songs. Optionally protect with a password (4–128 chars) — recipients will be asked for it before they can view or download. Requires the sharing permission; filtered discovery also requires Library read access. The bounded selection supports up to 250 Tracks.

track_group_ids.description: Explicit list of song IDs to share

bucket_id.description: Share all songs in this bucket

expiration_days.description: Days until link expires (default: 30, use 0 or null for never)

per_track_permissions.description: Per-track permission overrides keyed by track/track-group ID

track_files.description: Explicit per-track file selection snapshot keyed by track/track-group ID

track_order.description: Explicit display order for shared tracks

filters.description: Optional share filter snapshot to persist with the link

bucket_artwork_url.description: Bucket artwork URL to use on the share page

custom_share_image_attribution.description: Attribution text for the custom share image

password.description: Optional password (4–128 chars). When set, recipients must enter this to view or download the share. Password is hashed server-side — never returned in responses.

tools.name: list_shares
tools.description: List all existing share links with URLs, titles, counts, and advanced configuration fields

tools.name: delete_share
tools.description: Delete/revoke a share link so it can no longer be accessed

tools.name: export_split_sheet
tools.description: Generate an authenticated split-sheet export for selected songs or a bucket.

tools.name: list_public_shares
tools.description: List owned public share links with complete-page coverage. Requires new sharing.read consent. These links are separate from collaborator folder shares.

tools.name: get_public_share
tools.description: Read one owned public share, its version and supported properties. A link does not prove local file readiness.

tools.name: get_collaborator_share_status
tools.description: Read recipient-specific collaborator share permissions and delivery state for an owned Track. Delivery and local file readiness are separate.

tools.name: prepare_collaborator_share
tools.description: Prepare sharing one owned Track with one exact existing collaborator assignment. recipient_id is the Track assignment ID from collaborator status. Review the returned app handoff before execute_share_action. Never use the all-recipient legacy tool for a selected recipient.

tools.name: prepare_collaborator_share_revocation
tools.description: Prepare revoking one exact collaborator share. Requires sharing and destructive authority. The preview closes this recipient's direct, Track-membership and same-Track Bucket-child paths. Other recipients, other Tracks, Bucket membership and owner files remain unchanged. Review in the app before execution.

tools.name: prepare_public_share_update
tools.description: Prepare a supported patch to an existing public share. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Download changes need trusted review. Password/file selection changes use the trusted app until a secret-safe handle contract is available.

tools.name: prepare_public_share_revocation
tools.description: Prepare revoking an owned public link. Requires sharing and destructive authority. This does not revoke collaborator folder shares. Review before execution.

tools.name: list_share_inbox
tools.description: List the authenticated receiver's share inbox. Direct assignments, Bucket-child shares and Bucket aggregate rows remain separate. Contact details require collaborators.read.

tools.name: get_share_inbox_item
tools.description: Read one exact receiver-bound share inbox item. The source kind and immutable IDs must match; Bucket rows cannot become direct assignment targets.

tools.name: list_share_outbox
tools.description: List the authenticated owner's share outbox. Recipient filtering is bounded discovery only and never an execution target.

tools.name: get_share_outbox_item
tools.description: Read one exact owner-bound share outbox item using its immutable source reference.

tools.name: get_direct_share_delivery_status
tools.description: Read separate access, provider delivery and local readiness for one direct Track assignment.

tools.name: prepare_accept_track_invitation
tools.description: Prepare accepting one exact pending Track invitation for the authenticated receiver. Trusted app approval is still required and acceptance does not prove local import.

tools.name: prepare_decline_track_invitation
tools.description: Prepare declining one exact pending Track invitation for the authenticated receiver. Independent access and files remain unchanged.

tools.name: prepare_leave_direct_share
tools.description: Prepare leaving one exact direct Track share for the authenticated receiver. Independent Bucket access remains available.

tools.name: prepare_resend_collaborator_invitation
tools.description: Prepare resending one exact pending collaborator invitation owned by the authenticated account. The server resolves the stored recipient and does not create a second assignment.

tools.name: prepare_revoke_collaborator_share
tools.description: Prepare revoking one exact owned collaborator share. Trusted review enumerates the same-recipient Track and Bucket-child effects and requires destructive authority.

tools.name: list_track_offers
tools.description: List incoming, outgoing or all participant-scoped Track Offers. Follow every cursor before claiming a complete list. Offer state is separate from normal Track access and local readiness.

tools.name: get_track_offer_relationships
tools.description: Read incoming or outgoing Offer relationships. Friend status and offered/accepted access are separate. Roster labels require collaborators.read.

tools.name: get_track_offer_content
tools.description: Read exact authorized Offer bounces and feedback. Comments require bounce_id. Keep the same filters and limit while following next_cursor until coverage.complete and feedback_coverage.complete are both true. Provider availability is separate from local files. This does not add a comment or grant full Track access.

tools.name: get_track_offer_playback
tools.description: Get the available authenticated playback and feedback handoff for an exact offered bounce. This does not control the desktop player or claim playback started. No provider credential is returned.

tools.name: prepare_friend_designation
tools.description: Prepare adding or removing a one-way Friend designation. Friend status does not authorize sending, sharing, credits, or Offers. The trusted preview must disclose existing audience-rule effects. Requires new collaborators.write consent.

tools.name: prepare_track_offer
tools.description: Prepare one audition-only Offer to an exact resolved recipient account UUID. Requires rights.write and collaborator identity access. Friend status alone never authorizes this action. A message field is unsupported by the domain.

tools.name: prepare_track_offer_activation
tools.description: Prepare accepting one incoming Offer through the existing share backend. Requires rights.write and sharing.write. Native file readiness may remain blocked. Review the exact role and access effect in the app.

tools.name: prepare_track_offer_decline
tools.description: Prepare declining one exact incoming Offer. Preserve independent accepted access and files. Review in the trusted app.

tools.name: prepare_track_offer_revocation
tools.description: Prepare revoking one exact outgoing Offer. Ending accepted access also requires destructive authority. Preserve independent direct/Bucket paths and owner files.

tools.name: prepare_track_offer_sender_block
tools.description: Prepare blocking future Track Offers from one exact sender account. Scope is Offers only. Existing accepted sharing and Friend designations remain separate.

tools.name: execute_share_action
tools.description: Execute the exact plan after trusted app approval. MCP cannot approve it. Provide only the server plan/approval references and original idempotency key. Read the receipt after an unknown outcome; do not resend.

tools.name: execute_track_offer_action
tools.description: Execute the exact plan after trusted app approval. MCP cannot approve it. Provide only the server plan/approval references and original idempotency key. Read the receipt after an unknown outcome; do not resend.

tools.name: execute_friend_action
tools.description: Execute the exact plan after trusted app approval. MCP cannot approve it. Provide only the server plan/approval references and original idempotency key. Read the receipt after an unknown outcome; do not resend.

tools.name: get_mcp_action_plan
tools.description: Read an account/client-bound plan or operation. The server rechecks the original action scopes and policy. Unknown outcomes require this readback.

tools.name: get_mcp_operation
tools.description: Read an account/client-bound plan or operation. The server rechecks the original action scopes and policy. Unknown outcomes require this readback.

tools.name: cancel_mcp_action_plan
tools.description: Cancel the exact prepared plan or request a safe operation stop. expected_version is the saved integer plan_version or operation_version. Cancellation cannot undo completed effects. The server rechecks the original action authority.

tools.name: cancel_mcp_operation
tools.description: Cancel the exact prepared plan or request a safe operation stop. expected_version is the saved integer plan_version or operation_version. Cancellation cannot undo completed effects. The server rechecks the original action authority.

tools.name: list_bucket_members
tools.description: List the members and child-share delivery state for one Bucket. Contact details are omitted unless explicitly requested with collaborators.read authority.

tools.name: list_bucket_invitations
tools.description: List Bucket invitations visible to the authenticated actor. Pending recipients can discover only their own invitations.

tools.name: get_bucket_sharing_status
tools.description: Read the membership, coverage and child-share status for one Bucket or one exact member.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_member_invite
tools.description: Prepare inviting or resending one exact Bucket recipient. The trusted app review shows the normalized recipient, exact Track set, exclusions and any Observer coverage remedies.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_member_role
tools.description: Prepare changing one exact Bucket member to editor or viewer. The owner and current membership revision are rechecked at review and execution.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_member_revocation
tools.description: Prepare revoking one exact active or pending Bucket member. This preserves the membership row for audit and reconciles its child shares.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_invitation_acceptance
tools.description: Prepare accepting the authenticated actor's pending Bucket invitation. The server selects the recipient from the access token.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_leave
tools.description: Prepare leaving one accepted shared Bucket or declining the authenticated actor's pending invitation. The server selects the authenticated actor and revokes only that actor's membership and child shares.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_member_coverage_repair
tools.description: Prepare repairing collaborator coverage for one exact Bucket member. The review lists eligible and blocked Tracks and preserves source-owner requirements.

tools.name: prepare_bucket_share_import_retry
tools.description: Prepare retrying an existing authorized child Bucket share import. This does not confirm a local file import.

tools.name: execute_bucket_member_action
tools.description: Execute one exact Bucket member plan after trusted interactive app approval. MCP cannot approve the plan. Read the operation after an unknown outcome.

tools.name: get_bucket_property_status
tools.description: Read one owned Bucket's category tag, ordinary tag, canonical Public Page membership, and Friends audience processing status. Contact details are never returned.

tools.name: prepare_set_bucket_tags
tools.description: Prepare an atomic update to a Bucket's Projects category tag and ordinary tags. Omitted partitions stay unchanged; the trusted review shows the exact resulting partitions.

tools.name: prepare_set_public_page_bucket_visibility
tools.description: Prepare adding or removing one Bucket from the canonical Public Page collection. The review shows the exact page, complete current source and visible Track IDs, publication state, setup handoff, and preserved collection state. Future eligible direct Tracks can render under the persisted section and page limits.

tools.name: prepare_set_bucket_friends_audience
tools.description: Prepare changing one Bucket's Visible to Friends audience. The review shows complete current Friend and direct Track IDs, the dynamic current and future audience scope, and that enabling queues Offer reconciliation without granting ordinary access.

tools.name: execute_bucket_property_action
tools.description: Execute one reviewed Bucket property plan after trusted app approval. MCP cannot approve plans. Friend audience execution reports queued reconciliation separately from the persisted rule.

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: List owned internal playlists. Follow the cursor before treating the result as complete.

tools.name: get_playlist
tools.description: Read one owned internal playlist with a bounded ordered item page. Availability does not claim a local file exists.

tools.name: get_playlist_parameters
tools.description: Read the supported private playlist, layout and share parameter catalogue.

tools.name: get_playlist_file_options
tools.description: List safe opaque file choices for one Track in an owned playlist. Paths and credentials are never returned.

tools.name: get_playlist_share_file_options
tools.description: List safe opaque file choices for one Track in an owned playlist share, including legacy unlinked shares. Paths and credentials are never returned.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_create
tools.description: Prepare creating one private playlist and its unlisted stream-only live share. Track membership is fixed as one ordered set for direct execution.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_update
tools.description: Prepare updating the closed private playlist settings against an exact version for direct execution.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_add_tracks
tools.description: Prepare adding an ordered set of Tracks to a private playlist for direct execution. Existing membership is a reported no-op.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_remove_tracks
tools.description: Prepare removing an exact set of Tracks from a private playlist for direct execution without deleting Tracks or files.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_replace_tracks
tools.description: Prepare replacing complete private playlist membership for direct execution. An empty set clears membership only.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_reorder_tracks
tools.description: Prepare reordering a complete private playlist permutation for direct execution.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_update_layout
tools.description: Prepare updating a private playlist layout against its exact layout revision for direct execution.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_delete
tools.description: Prepare deleting one private playlist. Tracks and owned files are preserved; linked-share effects are fixed for direct execution.

tools.name: get_playlist_share
tools.description: Read one owned playlist share and its closed settings. Password plaintext is never returned.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_share_create
tools.description: Prepare creating a public share from one exact private playlist revision. File selections and permissions remain closed for direct execution.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_share_update
tools.description: Prepare updating one owned playlist share against its exact share and optional source playlist revisions for direct execution.

tools.name: prepare_playlist_share_revoke
tools.description: Prepare revoking one owned playlist share for direct execution. The private playlist and its Tracks remain.

tools.name: execute_playlist_action
tools.description: Execute one exact prepared private playlist or linked share plan under the authorized OAuth grant. Fresh direct plans do not need app review; legacy approved plans may include approval_id. Read operation status after an unknown result.

tools.name: import_royalty_earnings
tools.description: Import agent-prepared royalty earnings rows. Parse and reconcile the source sheet first, resolve matched songs to track_group_id values, and submit one statement per call.

filename.description: Original statement filename or stable source label.

source_provider.description: Statement provider, for example musicbed, tunecore, bmi, lyrichouse, or agent.

track_group_id.description: Matched Producer Dashboard track_group_id. Omit for unmatched or ignored rows.

match_status.description: Use matched/confirmed only when track_group_id is supplied.

net_amount_due.description: Net amount due for this royalty row.

rows.description: Normalized royalty ledger rows. Keep source sheet and row numbers for auditability.

currency.description: Default currency for rows that omit currency.

expected_total_net_amount.description: Optional statement total. The app rejects the import if row totals do not reconcile.

source_file_sha256.description: Optional source file SHA-256. If source content is supplied, it must match this value.

source_file_text.description: Optional raw CSV/TSV/TXT source content to retain in R2 for audit download.

source_file_base64.description: Optional base64 source file content, used for XLSX or binary statements.

source_file_key.description: Existing retained R2 source key, if uploaded before this call.
